about: The device library: native slides lifted from the references, sanitised (identity stripped, every word replaced, colours mapped to theme roles, type floored at 8pt) and fitted to the house rules. Place one with deckkit.devices.place and fill every slot; a sample left behind fails P19. capacity_words is every text slot at max_words; short_of_floor names the archetypes whose word floor the device cannot reach alone.
